Almost none. In terms of publicity, "Body Positivity" has been almost totally co-opted by obesity promoters. She proceeded to point out that now, in America, about 2/3 of Americans are owerweight/obese - they are the majority and largely can set the agenda for the movement, whereas the disabled don't have that kind of power. "I want body positivity to be able celebrating what our bodies can endure and still survive, how to care for them best, make them flourish, make them thrive.
